claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising:
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the USB host is embedded in an infotainment system.
3. The method according to claim 1, wherein the bypassing the USB bridge is performed by a USB routing switch.
4. The method according to claim 3, wherein the USB routing switch determines whether the consumer device is operating in the USB host mode or the USB device mode.
5. A USB communication management method for interconnecting sources of USB signals, the method comprising:
6. The USB communication management method according to claim 5, further comprising:

determining whether the second USB signals emanating from the consumer USB device indicate whether the consumer USB device is acting as a USB device; and routing the second USB signals emanating from the consumer USB device while acting as the USB device to the first USB host via the USB hub to the first USB host while bypassing the USB bridge.
7. The USB communication management method according to claim 5, wherein the first USB host is embedded in an infotainment system.
8. The method according to claim 5, wherein the routing of the second USB signals is performed by a USB routing switch.
9. The method according to claim 8, wherein the USB routing switch determines whether the second USB signals emanate from the second USB host.
10. A USB communication management method for interconnecting sources of USB signals, the method comprising:
11. The USB communication management method according to claim 10, further comprising:

determining whether the second USB signal emanates from a USB device; and establishing the second communication path via a USB hub between the first USB host and the consumer USB device which bypasses the USB bridge in accordance with the second USB signal emanating from the USB device.
12. The method according to claim 10, wherein the second communication path does not include the USB bridge.
13. The USB communication management method according to claim 12, wherein the first USB host is embedded in an infotainment system.
14. The method according to claim 10, wherein the establishment of the second communication path is performed by a USB routing switch.
15. The method according to claim 14, wherein the USB routing switch determines whether the second USB signal emanates from a USB device.
